title: Sean Payton pleased with how fast Jaylen Waddle is picking up the Broncos' offense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean Payton pleased with how fast Jaylen Waddle is picking up the Broncos' offense
sources.description: The Broncos have just started their Organized Team Activities, and newly acquired wide receiver Jaylen Waddle is already impressing head coach Sean Payton.
